src/ollama/start-can3a-max-ornith1.5-35b-a3b-official-q6-gguf-ollama-3gpu.sh

Shell · Tier B

Import a cached Ornith Q6 GGUF and serve it through Ollama.

Usage

Use an installed Ollama binary and the local official Q6 model; the HTTP server defaults to port 11434.

Inputs

MODEL_FILE/cache discovery, OLLAMA_BIN, MODEL_ALIAS, RECREATE_MODEL, CUDA scheduling controls, SERVER_HOST and CLIENT_OLLAMA_HOST.

Side effects

Writes a temporary Q6 Modelfile, probes /api/version, starts Ollama only if unavailable and creates the alias when absent or explicitly requested.

Cleanup

The trap removes the temporary Modelfile and stops only a server started by this wrapper. Existing servers and imported model aliases remain.

@see src/vllm/README.md
